versions.changelog:
- Default model updated from `u1-insuremed` to `u2-med`.
- Removed sample file: `skill-card.md`.

med-llm-knowledge-qa v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides medical exam, specialty Q&A, literature comprehension, terminology explanations, and synonym matching via an internal medical LLM.
- Supports task-specific prompts using --task for flexible scenario switching.
- Accepts questions via command line, input file (including .jsonl/.json/text), or stdin.
- Outputs structured JSON with model responses and meta info; offers text-only mode.
- Allows full control of LLM parameters (model, API URL, temperature, etc.).
- Clearly states compliance/disclaimer requirements for sensitive data.
